name: partner_country_state_required
summary: Makes the state or province field mandatory on contact addresses for countries that have federal states. Users cannot save an address in such a country without choosing a state. It is set through the country settings and applies on the contact form address section.

name: partner_deduplicate_acl
summary: Lets users other than sales settings managers run the contact deduplication tool by adding new permission groups. An admin sets a user's deduplication level (manual or automatic) in the user's access rights. The tool is found under Contacts, Tools, Deduplicate Contacts.

name: partner_deduplicate_by_ref
summary: Adds the contact Reference field as a criterion the deduplication wizard can use to find duplicate contacts. Users tick Reference in the search section of the wizard. Found under Contacts, Tools, Deduplicate Contacts.

name: partner_deduplicate_by_website
summary: Adds the contact Website field as a criterion the deduplication wizard can use to find duplicate contacts. Users tick Website in the search section of the wizard. Found under Contacts, Tools, Deduplicate Contacts.

name: partner_deduplicate_filter
summary: Lets the deduplication wizard leave some contacts out of the search. Users can exclude individuals or companies, or contacts with or without a parent company. The options appear in the Exclude contacts having section of the wizard.

name: partner_disable_gravatar
summary: Turns off Odoo's automatic lookup of contact pictures on gravatar.com when an email address is entered. This stops email addresses from being sent to a third party service. It is a technical behaviour change with no setting of its own.

name: partner_duns
summary: Adds a DUNS number field to contacts, the nine-digit business identifier from Dun and Bradstreet. It also shows other contacts that share the same DUNS number. The field is on the contact form.

name: partner_email_check
summary: Checks and cleans contact email addresses. Addresses are converted to lowercase and can be checked for valid syntax, unique use across contacts, and whether the domain can receive mail. These checks are switched on in Settings and need the email-validator Python package.

name: partner_email_duplicate_warn
summary: Shows a warning banner on a contact form when another contact has the same email address. This helps spot duplicate contacts before they are merged using the partner merge wizard. The banner appears on the contact form only.

name: partner_employee_quantity
summary: Adds an employee count to company contacts and groups it into named size ranges such as 10 to 50 employees. Ranges are managed under Contacts, Configuration. The fields appear on company contact forms.

name: partner_external_map
summary: Adds Map and Route buttons to the contact form that open the address in an online map. Each user picks a preferred map site and a start address for routes in their preferences. Supported sites include Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, Bing Maps, Here Maps and MapQuest.

name: partner_fax
summary: Adds a Fax field to the contact form so the fax number can be stored with each contact. It is a simple extra field next to the other phone details.

name: partner_firstname
summary: Splits the name of individual contacts into separate first name and last name fields. The full name is filled in automatically, and the order of names is set in General Settings. A Recalculate names button updates existing contacts after a change.

name: partner_firstname_auth_signup
summary: Links the first name and last name split to the customer sign-up form, so people registering on the website enter their names separately. It is a glue module that only installs when both sign-up and the first and last name feature are present.

name: partner_firstname_portal
summary: Lets logged-in portal customers edit their own first and last name from their account page. It is a glue module that works when both the portal and the first and last name feature are installed.

name: partner_identification
summary: Adds an ID Numbers tab on contacts to record identification numbers such as commercial register, VAT or driver license numbers. Each number has a type, issuer, place and validity dates. ID types are set up under Contacts, Configuration, Partner ID Categories.

name: partner_identification_eori
summary: Adds an EORI number as a category in the contact identification numbers feature. EORI is the EU customs identifier for traders. It is a small add-on that only adds the category.

name: partner_identification_gln
summary: Adds a GLN (Global Location Number) category to the contact identification numbers feature. GLN is the GS1 code that identifies a business location. It is a small add-on that only adds the category.

name: partner_identification_unique_by_category
summary: Lets an administrator require that ID numbers are unique within a chosen ID category, so the same number cannot be saved on two contacts. The option is set on each ID category. It extends the Partner Identification Numbers feature.

name: partner_industry_parent
summary: Adds a parent and child structure to partner industries, so an industry can sit under a broader one such as Technology under Services. Full industry names show the path. It is a base change to the industry list used on contacts.

name: partner_industry_secondary
summary: Adds secondary industries to contacts, so one contact can belong to several sectors alongside its main industry. It can also turn on industries for individuals, not just companies. Industries are managed under Contacts, Configuration.

name: partner_interest_group
summary: Adds an Interest Group field to contacts where users tag what each partner is interested in. The groups are configurable by the user. Useful for grouping and reaching partners by topic, such as advocacy or events.

name: partner_is_company_auth_signup
summary: Asks people who register on the website whether they are an individual or a company. The answer is saved on their contact. It extends the customer sign-up form.

name: partner_label
summary: Prints address labels for selected contacts. Label width, height, margins and paper format are set per company under General Settings, with a preview button to check the layout before printing.

name: partner_manual_rank
summary: Lets users mark a contact as a customer or a supplier by hand, which Odoo otherwise sets automatically from invoices. A system setting turns off Odoo's automatic customer and supplier ranking so manual flags stay as entered. The flags can be used in filters.

name: partner_middlename
summary: Adds a Middle Name field so individual contacts can have first, middle and last names entered separately. The full name is built from the three parts, in an order chosen in General Settings. It cannot be installed with the second last name module.

name: partner_mobile_duplicate_warn
summary: Shows a warning banner on a contact form when another contact has the same mobile number. Numbers are put in standard format first, so matches are reliable. It helps spot duplicates before using the partner merge wizard.

name: partner_multi_relation
summary: Lets users record relationships between contacts, such as assistant of, sibling of or has contract with. Relation types, with optional start and end dates and limits on contact types, are set under Contacts, Relations. Each contact gets a list of its relations.

name: partner_multi_relation_archive_propagate
summary: When a company is archived, contacts linked to it by relation types marked Propagate archive are archived too, unless they have active users. Those contacts are restored when the company is unarchived. Relations with propagation switched off are not affected.

name: partner_multi_relation_function
summary: Lets a relation between two contacts carry its own job function, so a person can be a CEO at one company and a volunteer at another. The function shows in the relation's display name. Only relation types set to allow functions can use it.

name: partner_noncommercial
summary: Adapts the contact screens for non-commercial organisations by renaming companies to organisations and changing related wording. It also adds filters often used by such groups, such as related organisation, responsible user and organisation type. Useful for charities, associations and similar bodies.

name: partner_phone_secondary
summary: Adds a second phone number field to contacts. It is a simple extra field on the contact form for an alternative number.

name: partner_phonecall_schedule
summary: Records the days and hours when each contact expects phone calls, using schedules. The contact's Phone calls tab shows whether now is a good time to call and a combined timetable. A filter lists the contacts that can be called right now.

name: partner_pricelist_search
summary: Lets users search contacts by their pricelist. The pricelist form gets a Customers smart button that lists the contacts using that pricelist. It is useful for finding who is on a given price list.

name: partner_pricelist_tracking
summary: Logs changes to a contact's pricelist, including automatic changes made when the country or state changes. This gives a record of who or what changed the price list so users can check and correct it. It is set up from the contact form and the chatter.

name: partner_priority
summary: Adds a priority level to contacts, used to rank customers or to flag how sensitive an account is. Priority levels are defined under Contacts, Configuration, Priorities, and set on the contact form.

name: partner_property
summary: Lets administrators add custom fields, called properties, to contacts, with one set for companies and another for individuals. Properties can be shown on kanban cards. They are created from the contact form using the properties control.

name: partner_purchase_manager
summary: Adds a Purchase Manager user field to contacts, showing which internal user handles purchasing for that contact. It sits on the Sales and Purchase tab of the contact form.

name: partner_rank_commercial_entity
summary: Combines customer and supplier ranks for all contacts that belong to the same commercial entity, so the rank is shared at the company level. A company and its contacts are treated as one relationship. It is a background change to how ranks are calculated.

name: partner_rank_single
summary: Stops a contact from being both a customer and a supplier at the same time. Attempts to set both are blocked with an error message. It is a validation rule on the contact record.

name: partner_readonly_security
summary: Adds a Partner edition permission that users can be switched off, so they can view contacts without creating, changing or deleting them. It is set on each user's access rights.

name: partner_ref_unique
summary: Lets each company require that contact reference numbers are unique, either for all contacts or only for companies. The option is set under Settings, Companies, in the Partners section. Duplicate references are then blocked.

name: partner_search_alias
summary: Adds a Search Alias field to contacts for alternative or unofficial names, such as nicknames or trading names. The alias can be searched, so a contact is found by any of its known names. The field sits under the reference field on the form.

name: partner_second_lastname
summary: Adds a second last name field for individual contacts, used in countries that record two surnames. When a full name is typed in, the module tries to split it into first name, last name and second last name. It extends the first and last name feature.

name: partner_shipping_policy
summary: Adds a shipping policy setting to contacts, which sets how deliveries are grouped on sales orders. Sales orders take the value from the delivery address contact, then the main contact, then a company default. The field is on the Sales and Purchase tab.

name: partner_stage
summary: Adds lifecycle stages to contacts, such as Draft, Active and Inactive, shown as a clickable status bar at the top of the contact form. Each stage can map to a related state. Stages are set up under Contacts, Configuration.

name: partner_store
summary: Adds a Store option to the contact type selector, for contacts that represent a store or shop location. The type is chosen with the radio buttons at the top of the contact form.

name: partner_street_city_search
summary: Adds a street search that matches the street, second street line and city fields together. Users can find a contact by typing part of an address in the contact search bar. It extends the normal contact search.

name: partner_subject_to_vat
summary: Adds a checkbox on contacts to record whether the company is subject to VAT. It gives a clear yes or no for VAT status on the contact record.

name: partner_supplier_ref
summary: Adds a Supplier Reference field to contacts so users can store the reference or code that a supplier uses for them. The field is on the contact record.

name: partner_supplier_ref_sequence
summary: Fills in the Supplier Reference automatically from a numbering sequence when a new supplier is created. Suppliers are told apart from customers using the manual rank feature. It saves typing a code for each new vendor.

name: partner_tier_validation
summary: Adds an approval workflow for new company contacts. A new company stays archived and in a To Approve stage until an approver signs it off, and the approval rules come from tier definitions. Users can send a contact for approval from the contact form.

name: partner_title_active
summary: Lets administrators archive contact titles such as Mr or Mrs instead of deleting them. Archived titles are hidden from new contacts but kept on existing ones. It is a base change to the titles list.

name: partner_title_order
summary: Adds a sequence to contact titles so they are listed in a chosen order rather than alphabetically. It is a small base change to the titles list.

name: partner_type_base
summary: Technical base module that adds flags to contacts for address types, such as whether a contact is an individual, whether its address is read only, and whether it can be a parent or child. Other modules use these flags to build custom address types. It has no screens of its own.

name: partner_tz
summary: Shows the time zone field on the contact form and adds helper functions for working with time zones. Users can see and set the time zone for each contact. It is a base and display change with no new workflow.

name: partner_vat_unique
summary: Stops two customers or suppliers from having the same VAT number. Empty VAT fields are not treated as duplicates. The rule is switched on in Settings.

name: purchase_supplier_rank
summary: Marks a contact as a supplier as soon as a purchase order is created for it. Normally Odoo only does this when a vendor bill is entered. It is a background update in the purchasing flow.

name: sale_customer_order_frequency
summary: Adds order timing statistics to contacts: average days between orders, days since the last order, and estimated days until the next order. These appear in the Sale group of the Sales and Purchase tab. They help sales teams see buying patterns and plan follow-ups.

name: sale_customer_rank
summary: Marks a contact as a customer as soon as a sales order is created for it. Normally Odoo only does this when an invoice is posted. It is a background update in the sales flow.

name: sale_partner_company_group
summary: Adds a company group field to sales orders, so an order can be tied to a group of related companies. The group comes from the base company group feature. It appears on the sales order form.

name: nutritional_info
summary: Stores nutrition facts for each product, such as energy and fat values, with a reference quantity and unit. Users print a Nutritional Info report from the product. The types of values shown and their order are set under General Settings.

name: nutritional_info_stock_lot
summary: Lets each lot or batch of a product have its own nutrition values, which override the product values on the Nutritional Info report. A report for a lot combines lot values with the product's own data. It is set up on the lot form.

name: pos_product_cost_security
summary: Stops Point of Sale from failing for users who cannot see product cost. Without it, loading the POS data can raise a permission error. It is a glue module between the cost security and Point of Sale features.

name: product_abc_classification
summary: Sorts products into ABC levels, such as A for the most important, by the share of products or volume in a chosen period. Classification profiles hold the levels and are assigned to categories or products, and a scheduled job applies them. Profiles are set under Inventory, Configuration, Products.

name: product_abc_classification_sale_stock
summary: Adds an ABC profile that ranks products by how many sales order lines were delivered in a period. Products are then graded A, B or C by how often they sell. It is set up from the ABC classification profile under Inventory.

name: product_assortment
summary: Lets users define a product assortment, which is a filter with an explicit list of allowed products and a list of restricted products. Assortments are applied to customers to control what they can see or buy. They are managed from the Product Assortment menu.

name: product_attachment_zipped_download
summary: Lets users download the attachments of selected products together as one zip file. It saves downloading product documents one at a time. It is available from the product list actions.

name: product_attribute_archive
summary: Lets users archive a product attribute or one of its values. Archived attributes can no longer be used on new products, but existing variants are not changed. It is set from the archive action on the attribute.

name: product_attribute_line_template
summary: Lets users define reusable attribute templates, such as a standard set of size and colour attributes. Applying a template to a product adds its attribute lines automatically. Templates are created under Settings, Attribute Templates.

name: product_attribute_value_avoid_auto_fill
summary: Adds an option on a product attribute that stops its values from being filled in automatically on product templates. It applies to attributes with variant creation set to Never. Users then choose the values by hand.

name: product_attribute_value_dependent_mixin
summary: Technical base that lets other models tie their records to particular product variants or attribute values, using computed filters. Developers use it so each feature does not have to write its own variant filter. It has no screens of its own.

name: product_attribute_value_menu
summary: Adds a list of all attribute values, with the attribute and value shown, under the Attributes menu. It also adds an Attribute Values Extra Prices list under Sales Configuration, where extra prices per product can be edited and imported. Extra prices can be changed in the list view.

name: product_barcode_required
summary: Makes the barcode field required on products when the company setting is on. The barcode is filled in from the internal reference by default. The setting is turned on under General Settings, Products.

name: product_catalog_stock
summary: Adds the product catalog to draft stock transfers, so users can search for products and add them quickly to a receipt or delivery. It saves adding lines one by one. The catalog button appears on the transfer form.

name: product_category_active
summary: Lets users archive a product category to hide it from use. Archiving is blocked if products are still in the category or in its sub-categories. The archive button is on the category form.

name: product_category_code
summary: Adds a Code field to product categories, so each category can carry a short identifier. It is a simple extra field on the category form.

name: product_category_name_translatable
summary: Lets product category names be translated into other languages. A setting chooses which language is used for full category names in lists and reports. It works around a limit in standard Odoo.

name: product_category_product_link
summary: Adds a link from each product category to the products directly in it, so the products can be listed from the category. Products in sub-categories are not included. It is a technical link used by other features.

name: product_category_tag
summary: Lets users attach tags to product categories, such as labels for grouping or reporting. Tags are added in a Tags tab on the category form. Tags are managed under Inventory, Configuration, Product Categories.

name: product_category_type
summary: Adds a Type to product categories, set to View or Normal. View categories can only hold other categories, and normal categories hold products, which stops users from picking a parent category for a product. It restores a feature that was in Odoo before version 10.

name: product_category_uom
summary: Sets a default unit of measure on each product category, which new products in that category inherit. It saves choosing the unit for each product. The default is set on the category form.

name: product_code_mandatory
summary: Makes the internal reference a required field on products, so a product cannot be saved without one. Products that had no reference when the module was installed get a temporary one. It applies to the product form.

name: product_code_unique
summary: Stops two products from sharing the same internal reference, so each code or SKU is unique across the database. Products without a reference get a temporary one when the module is installed. The check runs when a product is saved.

name: product_company_default
summary: Sets the user's company as the default company on new product templates. It saves choosing the company each time a product is created. It is a small default change on the product form.

name: product_cost_security
summary: Adds security groups that control who can see and who can edit the product cost price. Users without access do not see the Cost field on product forms. Access is granted per user in Settings, Users, under Product costs.

name: product_cost_security_stock_account
summary: Keeps stock operations working for users who cannot see product costs. Without it, stock moves can fail with a permission error when valuation entries are created. It is a glue module between cost security and stock valuation.

name: product_customerinfo
summary: Adds a Customers section to the product Sales tab, where each customer gets its own product name, product code, price, minimum order quantity and date range. Pricelist rules can then use these customer prices. It works like the vendor price list but for customers.

name: product_dimension
summary: Adds length, width and height fields to products and product variants, with a dimensional unit of measure. The volume is calculated from the three dimensions. The fields are on the product Inventory tab.

name: product_drained_weight
summary: Adds a drained weight field to products, for the weight of the product without its liquid, such as the fill weight of a tinned food. The field is on the product Inventory tab.

name: product_eprel
summary: Connects to the EU EPREL product database to pull energy labels and product fiche links for products that have a model identifier and an EPREL category. Users can fetch data on demand from the product form or through a scheduled sync. An EPREL API key is entered under General Settings, Integrations.

name: product_form_pricelist
summary: Lets users edit fixed-price pricelist items straight from the product form, so the price for a customer group can be set without going to the pricelist. It can also hide the standard sales price field. The fixed prices are listed on the product form.

name: product_get_price_helper
summary: Adds a helper that computes a product's price from its pricelist, fiscal position, company and date, and returns the value, discount and tax status. It is a developer tool for other modules and has no screens of its own.

name: product_ingredient
summary: Records the ingredients and allergens of each product and of each lot, with a percentage for each ingredient. Users can print an ingredients label report. Allergen and ingredient lists are kept in the product's Ingredients tab.

name: product_list_price_from_pricelist
summary: Sets product sales prices from the rules of a chosen pricelist. An Update Product Prices button applies the pricelist rules to all products in one go. The pricelist is chosen in Sales settings.

name: product_logistics_uom
summary: Lets each product use its own unit of measure for weight and volume, such as litres instead of cubic metres. A default unit can be set for weight, volume and length under General Settings. The values are still stored in the standard units behind the scenes.

name: product_lot_sequence
summary: Lets each product have its own lot or serial number sequence, which is proposed when new lots are created for that product. The sequence has a prefix, padding and next number. The option is on the Inventory tab of products tracked by lot.

name: product_main_supplierinfo
summary: Shows the main vendor of a product on the product form. The main vendor is the preferred supplier for that product. It is a display addition to the product record.

name: product_manufacturer
summary: Adds a manufacturer, the manufacturer's product name, code and web address to products. These fields are on the product form. They help record who makes a product and the code they use for it.

name: product_medical
summary: Adds a base set of medical product fields to products, such as CE certificate link, medical device class, drug category, PPE category, in vitro diagnostic type and declarations of conformity. It is a starting structure for medical and regulated products. The fields are on the product form.

name: product_multi_category
summary: Lets a product belong to several extra categories as well as its main category. The extra categories are for classification only and do not change pricing, stock or sales behaviour. The field is on the product form.

name: product_multi_price
summary: Lets a product have several named prices, such as wholesale or retail, shown in an Other Prices list. Those prices can then be used as the base for pricelist formulas. Price names are defined under Settings, Technical, Database Structure.

name: product_net_weight
summary: Adds a net weight field to products and renames the existing weight field to Gross Weight. Users can record both the weight of the product alone and its weight with packaging. Both are on the product Inventory tab.

name: product_next_reception_date
summary: Shows the next expected receipt date for a product, based on incoming transfers. It helps users see when new stock is due. The date appears on the product form.

name: product_origin
summary: Adds a country and state of origin to products, showing where the product is made or grown. The fields are on the General Information tab of the product form. They can be used for labelling and customs paperwork.

name: product_packaging_archive
summary: Lets users archive product packagings so they are no longer offered for new orders or transfers. Existing packagings are not changed. It adds an active flag to packagings.

name: product_packaging_calculator
summary: Adds a helper that works out how many of each packaging size make up a given quantity, such as pallets, big boxes and boxes for 2860 units. It is a developer helper that returns the breakdown, and shows it as text on products. It is used when picking stock by packaging.

name: product_packaging_calculator_packaging_level
summary: Changes the packaging breakdown text to use packaging level codes, such as 1PL or 2TU, instead of full packaging names. It joins the packaging calculator with the packaging level feature. It is a display change only.

name: product_packaging_dimension
summary: Stores the length, width, height, weight and volume of each product packaging, with units of measure. These are shown on the packaging line of the product. Useful for shipping and warehouse planning.

name: product_packaging_level
summary: Lets users define packaging levels such as primary retail pack, secondary box and tertiary pallet, and attach each product packaging to one. Levels are managed under Inventory, Configuration, Products, Product Packaging Level. Package types can also be linked to a level.

name: product_packaging_level_salable
summary: Blocks sales order lines that use a packaging which is not set to be sold at its level. Each packaging level has a Can be sold setting that decides which packagings appear on sales order lines. It adds a check when the order line is saved.

name: product_packaging_level_vendor
summary: Marks a packaging level as vendor specific, meaning it is the pack a supplier uses rather than one for customers. It is a flag on the packaging level used when working with suppliers.

name: product_packaging_unit_price_calculator
summary: Adds a wizard that works out a unit price from a packaging price, using the packaging quantity. Buttons next to the sales price, supplier price and pricelist items open the wizard, and the result is saved to that field. The sale price of each packaging is shown on the product's Inventory tab.

name: product_pricelist_alternative
summary: Lets a pricelist have alternative pricelists, so a product's price becomes the lowest of the reference price and the alternatives. A rule set to ignore alternatives keeps its own price. It is set up on the pricelist form.

name: product_pricelist_assortment
summary: Creates pricelist items automatically from product assortments, so a price applies to all products in an assortment. It links the assortment feature to pricelists. Assortment items are listed on the pricelist form.

name: product_pricelist_by_contact
summary: Lets each contact have its own pricelist for sales, overriding the one from its parent company. The pricelist is set on the Sales and Purchases tab of a child contact. Changing the parent's pricelist overwrites the child contacts' pricelists.

name: product_pricelist_direct_print
summary: Lets users print a price list from the Sales product menu, from selected products or variants, from a pricelist, or from a customer. The printout shows the prices for the chosen pricelist and customer. Advanced pricelist access must be granted to users.

name: product_pricelist_direct_print_company_group
summary: Lets users print a price list for the products sold to a company group. Selecting a customer in the group fills the price list with the group's products. It extends the direct price list print.

name: product_pricelist_direct_print_website_sale
summary: Lets users group a printed price list by website public categories instead of internal categories. It is for shops that show products on the website by public category. It extends the direct price list print.

name: product_pricelist_direct_print_xlsx
summary: Lets users export a price list as an Excel-style spreadsheet, in addition to printing it. The option appears in the price list print wizard. It extends the direct price list print feature.

name: product_pricelist_discount_by_range
summary: Lets a pricelist give different discounts depending on the reference price, such as the cost, falling in each band. A product whose reference price is outside all bands gets no pricelist and a warning. Bands are set on the pricelist item when Discount Type is By range.

name: product_pricelist_fixed_currency_rate
summary: Lets a pricelist rule that is based on another currency use a fixed exchange rate, instead of the live rate. The rate is set on the rule when it is computed from another pricelist. It keeps prices steady across currencies.

name: product_pricelist_item_list_view
summary: Adds a Pricelist rules menu that lists every pricelist rule in one searchable list. It is useful for finding one variant's price among many fixed-price rules. The menu is under Sales.

name: product_pricelist_margin
summary: Shows the cost, margin and margin percentage on each rule of a pricelist, so users can see the profit as they change the rule. The three columns appear on the price rules list of the pricelist form. It helps with price simulations while editing.

name: product_pricelist_product_price_history
summary: Keeps a log of every change to a fixed price in a pricelist, with the old and new price, the user and the date. A Pricelist History list under Sales, Products shows recent changes. Managers can also print product labels for new prices straight from this list.

name: product_pricelist_revision
summary: Lets users copy pricelist items into new versions with new date ranges and a percentage change, and see how much each fixed price moved from the last version. The Duplicate Item action on the Pricelist Items list starts this. It is a way to plan and record price increases.

name: product_pricelist_simulation
summary: Adds a See Price per Pricelist button on the product form that shows the product's price in every pricelist for a chosen date and quantity. It is useful for comparing prices across customer groups. The result opens in a dialog.

name: product_pricelist_supplierinfo
summary: Lets sales pricelist rules be based on the vendor prices on a product, with an optional sale margin added on top of the purchase price. Supplier minimum quantities can be ignored for the pricelist. The rules are set on pricelist items under Sales, Configuration.

name: product_print_category
summary: Lets products be grouped into print categories, each with its own label template. A product is flagged to reprint when chosen fields change, such as its name or price. Print jobs are started from Sales, Products, Print Categories, or from the product list actions.

name: product_product_template_link
summary: Adds a button on the product variant form that opens its product template. It saves navigating back to the template to edit shared fields. It is a small navigation addition.

name: product_profile
summary: Lets users set many product fields at once by choosing one profile on the product form, such as a profile for manufactured or purchased items. Profiles can also be used as search filters and groups. Profiles are created under Sales, Configuration, Product Profiles.

name: product_readonly_security
summary: Adds a Product edition permission that users can be switched off, so they can view products without creating, changing or deleting them. It is set on each user's access rights.

name: product_restricted_type
summary: Lets a product category be restricted to one product type, such as storable or service. Only categories that match a product's type are offered when that type is chosen, and saving a mismatch gives an error. The restriction is set on the category.

name: product_route_mto
summary: Marks a product as make-to-order when one of its routes is set to MTO, and adds an Is MTO flag to the product. It makes MTO products easy to find. It is a technical flag based on routes.

name: product_sale_description
summary: Adds a short sales description and a longer formatted sales description to products. These can be published to websites or marketplaces. The fields are on the product form.

name: product_sale_manufactured_for
summary: Lets users record which customers a product was made specifically for. On sales orders, the product choice is limited to products made for the selected customer. The field is on the product form.
